intro: Hand-crafted guides, architecture boilerplates, workshop code repositories, and cheat sheets built by GCET student builders for our community.

learningPaths.title: Cloud Foundations & Free Tier Mastery
learningPaths.description: Zero to confident on AWS. Master IAM user boundaries, budget alerts, EC2 instance launch, and S3 static hosting without incurring accidental charges.
modules: Setting up IAM with MFA & zero root key exposure
Configuring AWS Budgets & CloudWatch billing alarms ($0 threshold)
SSH into Ubuntu EC2 with Security Groups & Elastic IPs
Deploying your first static portfolio site on S3 + CloudFront

learningPaths.title: Modern Full-Stack on AWS Amplify Gen 2
learningPaths.description: Build production React / Next.js 15 applications with code-first AWS backend definitions in TypeScript.
modules: Amplify Gen 2 architecture & file-based backend configuration
Cognito Auth: Sign-up, social logins & JWT claims
DynamoDB data modeling & GraphQL / REST endpoints
CI/CD deployment pipelines on Amplify hosting

learningPaths.title: Serverless Microservices & Event Architecture
learningPaths.description: Build high-throughput, low-latency microservices that scale to zero when idle using Lambda, API Gateway, and DynamoDB.
modules: AWS Lambda lifecycle, layers & cold start optimizations
Amazon EventBridge for asynchronous decoupled event routing
DynamoDB Single-Table Design & Global Secondary Indexes (GSIs)
Infrastructure as Code using AWS CDK with TypeScript

learningPaths.title: Generative AI Systems with Amazon Bedrock
learningPaths.description: Construct enterprise-grade Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) applications using Claude, Llama 3, and vector embeddings.
modules: Bedrock Converse API and prompt engineering guardrails
Chunking documents & generating vectors with Amazon Titan
Vector indexing in OpenSearch Serverless and pgvector on RDS
Building full-stack AI streaming chat UIs with Next.js
learningPaths.recommendedFor: AI/ML Enthusiasts & Final Year Project Teams

items.title: AWS Free Tier Survival & Budget Safety Guide
items.description: Step-by-step checklist to avoid surprise bills: setting up $1 billing alerts, CloudWatch alarms, and auto-terminating test instances.

items.title: Next.js 15 + AWS Amplify Gen 2 Production Starter
items.description: A pre-configured boilerplate with TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Cognito auth wrappers, and DynamoDB CRUD hooks ready to clone.

items.title: Building RAG on Bedrock: Complete Workshop Repo
items.description: Full workshop source code containing document ingestion pipelines, OpenSearch vector index scripts, and streaming Lambda handlers.

items.title: Dockerizing & Deploying Node.js to AWS ECS Fargate
items.description: Multi-stage Dockerfile patterns, ECR push commands, task definition JSON templates, and ALB target group routing configurations.

items.title: AWS Certified Solutions Architect Associate (SAA-C03) Study Sheet
items.description: High-yield architectural comparison tables: S3 storage classes, EBS vs EFS, RDS Multi-AZ vs Read Replicas, and VPC Peering vs Transit Gateway.

items.title: Debugging 10 Common AWS Deployment Errors
items.description: Fixes for S3 403 Access Denied, CORS failures on API Gateway, Lambda VPC timeout bugs, and RDS connection security group misconfigurations.

items.title: Cloud System Design Interview Question Bank
items.description: Real systems design prompts solved with AWS architectures: URL shortener with DynamoDB, photo upload pipeline with S3 & SQS, and rate limiter with ElastiCache.

items.title: Infrastructure as Code with AWS CDK in TypeScript
items.description: Learn to define VPCs, Lambda functions, and DynamoDB tables in pure TypeScript with type checking and reusable construct libraries.
